newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Hospital Care revamps management.
newsitem.headline: Australian Hospital Care revamps management.

text.p: Hospital operator Australian Hospital Care Ltd said on Friday it would restructure senior management to pursue an aggressive growth strategy.
The changes would include the formation of an acquisition team, the appointment of a full-time business development director and the establishment of an executive committee.
Chief executive Mark Bryce said the company currently had tenders to run hospitals in three states as well as "other significant targets in Australia and offshore".
"It is appropriate to gear up now for the period of significant growth coming in the next few years," Bryce said in a statement.
Australian Hospital Care, which was floated last year, is Australia's third largest private hospital group.
